thread:
noah: Ugh, flight got cancelled at SJC. Can't make the 19:00 handoff. I'm still online but wifi is flaky. Requesting someone to take primary for the next ~4h so pages don't get missed. There's an active P0 on model-serving-gateway (latency spike + 5xx). Runbook link: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/model-gateway

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: model-serving-gateway 95th latency > 1500ms and 5xx rate > 3% for 2m. Incident ID: INC-2026-215. Pager channel: #pager-model-gateway. See https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-215

oliver: I can jump in as primary. Taking over now. Noah, any quick context?

noah: thanks oliver. Short context: After the midnight canary we saw increased tail latency from the gateway (mostly POST /v1/generate for long-context). Downstream hint: redis KV thundering under heavy prefix writes. Quick triage steps in runbook excerpt:

```
1) Check grafana -> model-gateway/latency, model-gateway/5xx-rate
2) kubectl -n infra get deploy model-gateway -o wide
3) check redis cluster memory and client count: redis-cli -h redis-primary INFO memory, CLIENT LIST
4) if 5xx due to redis timeouts, flip to read-replica fallback: `kubectl set env deploy/model-gateway REDIS_READ_FALLBACK=true`
5) increase gateway connection pool: patch configmap gateway-config batch_conn_pool=256
6) if rollback needed: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-gateway --to-revision=27`
```

noah: Also note kube nodes in us-west2 show high iowait — infra team is aware. If you need kernel-level changes or node reboot, tag @infra-pager.

emma: I'll be secondary and monitor logs. oliver, when you pick, can you also add a temporary suppression for the noisy alert (latency alert) for 10m while we triage?

oliver: added suppression for 10m. Setting higher sampling on traces for requests hitting long-context. Running `kubectl exec -n infra -c redis redis-primary -- redis-cli INFO memory` now.

devops-bot: @oliver Oncall swap command detected. To confirm run: `oncall swap --from noah --to oliver --duration 4h --incident INC-2026-215` Reply with `confirm` to proceed.

oliver: confirm

devops-bot: Swap accepted. Primary: oliver. Secondary: emma. Swap window: 2026-04-22T02:45:00Z -> 2026-04-22T06:45:00Z. Calendar and rotation doc updated. :white_check_mark:

infra-pager: Acknowledge. If you're seeing redis OOM or client backlog, we can temporarily bump maxclients and adjust vm.overcommit_memory. Tag messages `redis-throttle` so I pick them up fast. We can also cordon a noisy node and migrate pods.

oliver: redis memory looks high, fragmentation 23%, used 95% of cap. Client list shows lots of persistent clients from `embed-worker-*`. I'm going to enable READ_FALLBACK and scale gateway replicas from 4 -> 8 to reduce per-pod load: `kubectl scale deploy/model-gateway --replicas=8`

emma: Scaling now, just saw more 5xxs but tail latency dropping a bit. I'll keep tracing on. If 5xx > 5% for 3m, we follow rollback step.

noah: Thanks team. I updated the rotation sheet entry and added a note about the node iowait. Sorry for the chaos, will DM infra if I hear any more from ops at the airport. :sweat_smile:

oliver: Posting 30m status update on the incident page. If anyone escalates to infra L2, please use `infra-run` and include the `redis-throttle` tag. I'll be at my laptop for the swap window. :thumbsup:

emma: Watching logs, ready to take full primary if you need a break.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigation in progress. Updated runbook: applied redis read-fallback and scaled gateway replicas.

oliver: FYI turned on backlog alert for embed-worker to prevent cascading overload: `promtool put-rule backlog-high-rules`

infra-pager: Noted. If you end up needing node reboots, give a heads-up 10m before and we'll coordinate draining.

noah: Boarding now. Thanks all 6c2 (reach me if absolutely needed).
